name: Astral Arena — Season 1 Prelaunch
description: 45-day draft campaign connecting the first playable, Season 1 editorial episodes, gameplay clips and Steam-readiness. No auto-publish; dates are planning slots and Moon approval remains required.
objectives: Validate the first playable with family testers before public claims
Establish Astral Arena as one story across game, episodes and short-form content
Generate approved real-gameplay footage for trailer and Steam store assets
Build an audience before Steam release without promising unfinished online features
Switch CTA from follow/play-preview to Steam wishlist only after Coming Soon is actually live
